βασίλευεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβασίλευεν)
δαιμόνιε: δαιμόνιος — strange, uncanny, of one moved by a power beyond himself; as address ’strange one’ (tone from rebuke to affection); masc. voc. sg.
δμῳαὶ: δμῳή — female slave, serving-woman (fem. of δμώς); nom. pl.
δμῳῇσιν: δμῳή — serving-woman, slave-woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
δόμους: δόμος — house, hall; masc. acc. pl.: ’halls’ (plural for one dwelling)
δώματος: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. gen. sg., governed by the adv. εἴσω: ’within the house’ · also gen. sg. governed by διά: ’through the house’ (διὰ δώματος) · also gen. sg. of separation after a verb of sending out: δώματος ἐκπέμψῃσι ’send out of the house’
εἴσελθε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, come in; aor. imper. 2 sg.
εὖτε: εὖτε — when; epic temporal conj. (= Attic ὅτε)
θέουσα: θέω — run; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’running’
θήβῃ: Θήβη — Thebes; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in Thebes’
θήῃς: τίθημι — put, make; aor. subj. 2 sg., epic -ῃ- (= Attic θῇς): ’you may make (me) so-and-so’
θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
κακὴ: κακός — bad, harmful; adj., fem. nom. sg.
καλῷ: καλός — fair, fine; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀνέμῳ: ‘fine (wind)’
κιχήσεσθαι: κιχάνω — reach, overtake, befall; fut. inf. mid.: ’to befall’
κτεάτεσσιν: κτέαρ — possession, property; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
κῦμ: κῦμα — wave; neut. acc. sg., elided (κῦμ’ = κῦμα), object of ἀποέργει: ‘the wave’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: κῦμ’ ἐφόρει ’a wave bore (me)’
λώϊον: λώϊος (comparative λωΐων) — better, more desirable (= Attic βέλτιον); neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’something better’
μαλακοῖς: μαλακός — soft, gentle, mild; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
ναιετάοντας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (contracted ναιετῶντας; prose says οἰκέω): ’inhabited’
νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’ · also neut. acc. pl. as adv./predicative: ’unerringly, truly’ (νημερτέα πάντ’ ἐνέποντα ’telling all things unerringly’)
νύμφαι: νύμφη — nymph; also bride; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., in address: ’nymphs!’
ξὺν: σύν (epic ξύν) — with, together with; + dat.
οἴχεσθαι: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone off; pres. inf., perfect sense: ’to have gone off’ (in indirect statement after ἔφαντο)
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
ποθὴν: ποθή — a missing, a longing, a want of; fem. acc. sg., + gen. of the thing lacked
πολύδωρος: πολύδωρος — rich in gifts (rare; whether she brought gifts or was given them is not known); fem. nom. sg.
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
προφέρουσα: προφέρω — carry forward; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying (me) on’
τέτμεν: τέτμον (defective aor., ’find, come upon’) — find, come upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔτετμεν)
ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
τρώεσσ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., elided (Τρώεσσ’ = Τρώεσσι)
ἀγαπητὸν: ἀγαπητός — beloved, cherished (esp. of an only child); masc. acc. sg.
ἀληθέα: ἀληθής — true; adj., neut. acc. pl.: ‘the truth, true things’
ἀμφίπολος: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; nom. sg.
ἀμφιβέβηκεν: ἀμφιβαίνω — go about, encompass, envelop; perf. 3 sg. with present force (+ acc.): ’has enveloped’
ἀμφιπόλῳ: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; dat. sg.
ἀνάσσων: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’ruling’
ἀρήϊα: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀργεννῇς: ἀργεννός — shining white, white; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= -ῇσι; Attic -αῖς), agreeing with ὀΐεσσιν
ἄκουσον: ἀκούω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.
ἄνωγας: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with present sense); perf. 2 sg., epic: ’you bid’
ἄτης: ἄτη — ruin, blind folly sent by a god; fem. gen. sg., with εἵνεκα
ἄχεϊ: ἄχος — grief, distress; neut. dat. sg., epic ἄχεϊ (= Attic ἄχει)
ἐλέαιρε: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’pity!’ · also impf. 3 sg.: ’she pitied’ (θεὰ δ’ ἐλέαιρε)
ἐλεαίρεις: ἐλεαίρω — pity, have compassion on; pres. 2 sg., epic by-form of ἐλεέω
ἐλεύσομαι: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — go, come; fut. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I shall come’
ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. 2 sg.
ἐπειγομένη: ἐπείγω — press, drive; mid. hasten, press on; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’hastening’
ἐποτρύνει: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. 3 sg.
ἔκτανεν: κτείνω — kill; aor. 3 sg., epic ἔκτανε(ν) (= Attic ἀπέκτεινε)
ἔμπεδοι: ἔμπεδος — firm, steady, abiding; masc./fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’firm’
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔσομαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., middle form
ἔσσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf., epic (= Attic ἔσεσθαι)
ἔσσονται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔσονται)
ἥμην: ἧμαι — sit, remain; impf. 1 sg. (= Attic ἐκαθήμην): ’I sat’
ὄρνυθι: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μή in a prohibition: ’do not rouse’
ὑπότροπος: ὑπότροπος — returning, back again; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ‘back home’
